operative_context: The system shall ensure availability changes are applied immediately when relevant rental lifecycle events or availability controls are updated.
The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.
The system shall return availability status indicating whether the item is available or unavailable for the requested period.
## 4.2.3 The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information.
The system shall allow users to query item availability for a specified date range.
The system shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur.
The system shall allow authorized users to define availability restrictions for items.
The system shall allow authorized users to define maintenance periods for items.
The system shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records.
Availability status reflects the current lifecycle state of rent records.
The system shall mark items as unavailable during maintenance periods.
The system shall prevent rent creation during maintenance periods.
exceptions: Availability restrictions take precedence over normal availability.
Maintenance periods block rental activity and make items appear non-rentable.
conflicts_or_obsolete: Earlier discussion suggested using a single fallback delay after certain rental events, but this does not align with the current requirement for immediate availability synchronization.
